svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: The Signal vs Time plot on the Tracking tab: the title reads Beam held at 0.0 degrees and the update rate; the trace of one 22 second sweep by hand sits in a 30 second window of level in dBFS against time; hovering over a lobe peak reads its level.
